blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={["Confusing a collar joint with a head joint—collar joints exist _between_ wythes; head joints exist _within_ a single wythe.","Assuming stack bond is acceptable for lateral load resistance—stack bond is restricted to non-seismic, architectural applications only.","Treating cell voids as equivleant to cavity walls—cells are internal voids in individual units; cavities are air spaces between two wythes.","Specifying cavity wall air space outside the 51–114 mm range—thinner cavities reduce insulation; thicker spaces are wasteful and violate NBP limits.","Omitting header courses in multi-wythe masonry—without headers, the two wythes function independently and do not act as a composite wall."]} />
